Hello Parents,

家长们大家好，

Thank you everyone for participating in this season’s Peer Tutoring. We are very sorry that the lessons
taught by David and Taichi this summer had been very inconsistent. We had contacted the tutors many
times, however, we didn’t receive any actionable response. Because of this situation, we had decided to
end the season early. We apologize for your experience during this season. Normally, our tutors are
responsible and teach classes regularly. We hope to see you all in the Peer Tutoring Program in the future.
Thank you very much for your feedback and your patience and understanding.


感谢大家参加我们这一季的同伴辅导课程。我们很抱歉David和Taichi一直没有给大家好好上课。
我们多次联系过老师，但是我们没有收到老师们回应怎么把课上的更好。由于这个情况，我们决
定提前结束这一季给大家的课。我们十分抱歉您这一季的上课经历不好。通常，我们的老师们是
负责的并且会每一周按时教课的。我们希望能在下一季的同伴辅导项目中见到大家。非常感谢大
家的反馈以及大家的耐心和理解。

Thank you everyone.

谢谢大家。
